raw_text: Breaking: Encounter in Shopian, South Kashmir. Reports of civilian gathering near encounter site. Protest calls spreading rapidly on social media. Authorities expected to impose internet shutdown soon. Coded language being used in rally coordination — 'chai at uncle's house' appears to be a rally point reference. #Kashmir #Shopian
clean_text: Encounter in Shopian, South Kashmir with civilian gatherings. Protest calls spreading on social media with coded language for rally point coordination. Internet shutdown expected.
